description: This file defines the Zend_Http_UserAgent class, which manages user agent detection, configuration, and device identification within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for parsing server variables, matching user agent strings against device classes, and handling persistent storage of device info.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent
classes.description: Represents a user agent detection and management component, capable of parsing server variables, matching user agents to device classes, and storing device info persistently.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns a serialized string representation of the user agent object, including device class, config, and server info.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Rebuilds the user agent object from a serialized string, restoring device and configuration states.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Configures the object with an array of options, such as server variables, plugin loaders, and device preferences.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the device object representing device capabilities; creates and loads it if not already initialized.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the User-Agent string from server variables or default.

methods.name: setUserAgent
methods.description: Sets the User-Agent string in the server variables.

methods.name: getHttpAccept
methods.description: Returns the HTTP Accept header value.

methods.name: setHttpAccept
methods.description: Sets the HTTP Accept header value.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage handler, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Sets a custom storage handler for device info.

methods.name: getBrowserType
methods.description: Retrieves the current browser type detected.

methods.name: setBrowserType
methods.description: Sets the browser type, making it immutable thereafter.

methods.name: getServerValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific value from the server variables.

methods.name: setServerValue
methods.description: Sets a specific value in the server variables array.
